timeline.tweet: Finished work! I'm officially On Leave! TWITCHCON HERE I COME!
I used a special pen to get me back in the country yesterday ! 💜
Left the apartment to head to my parents place, then the airport tomorrow morning for another adventure. It was really hard to leave...😔
Oh man I was just waiting for my pay this week to buy the top tier one! Damn!
I’m going to France!
Just heard the air raid sirens across the city of Paris... definitely eerie.
And so my massive France adventure comes to an end, about to start the 24 or so hour trip home. I plan to stream when I do get back though! Stay Tuned!

Australian politics 😔 I feel you man. And I know what you mean, the idea of the good old fashioned discussion or debate is dead, simply because everyone seems to be too precious to consider another point of view. It’s depressing as heck.
Buy a house, with some land, stream, and live with a wide assortment of rescue creatures.
So one of our cockatiels laid eggs last week, and she and her bird-hubby, have been taking turns sitting on the eggs. Today the first egg hatched! YAY!
Here is the latest Woggle update. The baby cockatiels are growing and getting their feathers. They are both super super sweet!
#SydneyStorm and then the hail came!

2019 is the year when I will try to: 1. Get 50 concurrent viewers on Twitch 💜 2. Continue my weight loss journey, but remember that my weight doesn’t make me less valid, or less beautiful. 💛 3. Work towards a career in video games or esports. It’s my love and my passion ❤️
Its all out WAR on the Public Server! Good to be BACK! Watch at! #WBGUP #SupportSmallStreamers #SupportSmallerStreamers #twitchkittens #girlgamers #womanz
Slowly getting my Shape back! Feeling good and beautiful again.

One of my best friends in the entire world passed away after a head on collision yesterday evening. Her mum told us today. She bought her first apartment last month. I saw it for the first time last week. We were all going away together this weekend. This can’t be real
It’s 3am and my bed is calling me, but it was an amazing wedding! So surreal to watch my baby sister become a Mrs! Now to sleep for the next 2 weeks! Pic is me and fellow bridesmaid Laura ❤️

2009 -2019 Been a rough decade with Depression, Anxiety and PTSD. I gained 40-50kg trying to hide, which I have since struggled to lose. Triumph too. I completed 2 degrees and a diploma in that time. Secured a full time job on my own merit. Still beautiful ❤️ Here’s to 2029.
